chapter_summary: The wall accepts some colors and refuses others. Debolina learns that not every intention survives contact with its material.

spatality.place: a panel where two coats of colour meet, one holding, one lifting
spatality.route: along the join, where the wall shows what it will and will not take
spatality.texture: chalky refusal under the brush, a patch that drinks and a patch that beads

poetic_parameters.movement: Stoicism — accepting what cannot be changed, here the wall's own terms.
writing_skills: argument built from two contrasting material behaviours
personification held to a single consistent conceit
a conclusion that refuses to moralise the refusal
poetic_parameters.image_seed: a bead of pigment standing on the plaster instead of sinking in
poetic_parameters.volta: from reading refusal as failure to reading it as the material's honest answer
poetic_parameters.sonic_texture: hard k and p in keep, take, refuse, beading like the pigment
poetic_parameters.line_gesture: measured sentences of medium length; one clause held longer where the wall wins
poetic_parameters.variety_note: This is the book's most patient poem — nothing happens except a decision about what a surface will accept.
poetic_parameters.metaphor_family: absorption and refusal, thirst and stone, invitation and closedness
poetic_parameters.address: the plaster, as a party to a negotiation
poetic_parameters.closing_move: an unfinished thought about what the maker must therefore change in herself
